procedure: Compare approved application inventory to architecture; flag missing dependencies
expected_result: Every scoped application has an owner, dependency and migration disposition

procedure: Review target subnet, identity and logging checklist
expected_result: Required access paths and logs are documented; public access exceptions have an owner

procedure: Time a restore rehearsal from the designated recovery point
expected_result: Restore completes within the 60-minute exercise target and critical data validates

procedure: Compare source IDs, target IDs and approved exclusions
expected_result: Source count equals loaded plus approved exclusions plus unresolved rejects; critical unresolved rejects equal zero

procedure: Walk through traffic reversal and data-write freeze with the technical lead
expected_result: Rollback owner, traffic reversal, write handling and verification are specified

procedure: Have operations locate the runbook and route a sample incident
expected_result: Named support owner accepts escalation, monitoring and recovery responsibilities
